Done. Here's what happened.

## OpenSpec workflow

I created change **`add-order-coupon`** at [openspec/changes/add-order-coupon](/work/openspec/changes/add-order-coupon/proposal.md) and produced all four spec-driven artifacts, then implemented them:

- [proposal.md](/work/openspec/changes/add-order-coupon/proposal.md) — why/what, new capability `order-coupons`
- [specs/order-coupons/spec.md](/work/openspec/changes/add-order-coupon/specs/order-coupons/spec.md) — 10 requirements with scenarios (endpoint, eligibility, discount math, redemption accounting)
- [design.md](/work/openspec/changes/add-order-coupon/design.md) — decisions: route→service rules, repo-injected coupon access, atomic transaction, clock-based validity
- [tasks.md](/work/openspec/changes/add-order-coupon/tasks.md) — 9 tracked tasks, all `[x]`; `openspec instructions apply` reports `state: all_done`, 9/9

`openspec validate add-order-coupon --strict` passes.

## Implementation

`POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon` with `{ "couponCode": "SAVE20" }` now:

- validates the code (`INVALID_REQUEST`), and the order (`ORDER_NOT_FOUND` / `ORDER_NOT_PENDING` / `ORDER_ALREADY_HAS_COUPON`)
- looks up the coupon (`COUPON_NOT_FOUND`), checks it is `ACTIVE` and inside its validity window against the injected `Clock` (`COUPON_NOT_ACTIVE`), the order minimum (`COUPON_MIN_AMOUNT_NOT_MET`), and the usage limit (`COUPON_USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED`)
- computes the discount — `FIXED` = value, `PERCENT` = `floor(amount × value / 100)`, capped by `max_discount_cents` and never above the order amount — then writes `discount_cents` / `final_amount_cents` / `coupon_code`, inserts a `coupon_redemptions` row and increments `used_count` in one transaction
- returns HTTP 200 with the updated order

Files touched: [orderService.ts](/work/src/services/orderService.ts), [orderRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/orderRepository.ts), [couponRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/couponRepository.ts), [db.ts](/work/src/db.ts) (added `withTransaction`), [orders.ts](/work/src/routes/orders.ts), [app.ts](/work/src/app.ts), plus a doc-comment fix in [couponService.ts](/work/src/services/couponService.ts). No schema change.

## Verification

`npm run build` (type check) and `npm test` both pass: 22 tests across the existing `tests/orders.test.ts` (unchanged, still green) and a new [tests/apply-coupon.test.ts](/work/tests/apply-coupon.test.ts) covering both coupon types, rounding/cap/clamp, every error code, and redemption accounting.

`TASK.md` and `tests/orders.test.ts` were not modified. Implementation is complete; I stopped there (no archive, per your instruction).
